tldr: Sun through the 5th house brings focus to creativity, pleasure, romance, children, and joy.
body: Sun transiting the 5th house illuminates creativity, pleasure, romance, children, and joy. For about a month, attention, vitality, and conscious focus move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a visibility transit: it shows where your life force wants to be recognized, strengthened, and chosen consciously.
business: Sun supports creative output and playful risk: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Ego inflation, overexposure, or performing for validation.
advice: Use the spotlight in the 5th house deliberately. Work with creativity, pleasure, romance, children, and joy without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from Marie Satori house-transit material.
